programme.title: Airgunner Challenge
programme.desc: With the two teams of 3 established, the teams compete in a game of Around the World. The course is set up in a half circle with a single bell-shaped target at the center. In the end, someone will be going to the Pellet Gallery in our second Elimination Shootoff!
